stem: Three bottles of colourless liquids labelled **F**, **G** and **H** contain separate pure samples of the compounds ethanal, propanal or propanone but **not** necessarily in that order.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the functional group in ethanal, propanal and propanone.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State a reagent and the relevant observation that confirm that **F**, **G** and **H** have the same functional group.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
Separate samples of **F**, **G** and **H** are each tested with Tollens' reagent and with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$. The observations are shown in Table 6.1.

Table 6.1

|  | Tollens' reagent | alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **F** | no observable change | pale yellow precipitate |
| **G** | silver mirror | pale yellow precipitate |
| **H** | silver mirror | no precipitate |

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Use Table 6.1 to name the organic compounds in bottles **F**, **G** and **H**.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the yellow precipitate produced when alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ is added to separate samples of **F** and **G**.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Compound **J** does **not** contain the same functional group as **F**, **G** and **H**. Compound **J** also reacts with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$ to produce a pale yellow precipitate.

Suggest the structure of compound **J**.
